name: doodka-scan
description: QR и Data Matrix с фотографий: наклейки от 20 до 100 мм, PDF и печать

scripts.test: npm run test:updates && node --test tests/unit/readiness.cjs && playwright test
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:dir && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never
